23 MORE Things You STILL Didn’t Know In Ocarina Of Time Remake
In the Ocarina Of Time Remake, there are a vast amount of both old and new secrets, and we uncover many of them including hidden sound features right in the palm of your hand, some absolutely wild glitches, and some references that call back to some really cool sources.
